taipei: Landed in Taipei after a 7 hour flight to Seattle, followed by a 12 hour flight to Taiwan. Spend the first 4 days jet-lagged AF but was a fun time and the food was great!
jiufen: Jiufen for the night! Inspired the Studio Ghibli movie Sprited Away. Lots of lanterns...
taipei-again: Back in Taipei for a single night. Ate some street food and went shopping for cute EasyCard
sun-moon-lake: A day trip to Sun Moon Lake. Biked around the lake, got street food and then watched the sunset on kayak
yunlin-again: Took our time coming back to Yunlin. Visited a mosaic museum
intro:
First trip to Taiwan! Spent a full month! First 2 weeks were travel and exploring this beautiful island. Eating tons of good food and boba. Last 2 weeks, remote work; 4pm - 1am 
(-﹏-)
mianyue-line: About ten miles and six hours along the old Mianyue railway line, and a little dangerous in places. The highlight of the trip for me. A 10/10 hike, would recommend
